title: Law to set default deadlines for agency reports to Council
summary: This bill would create a standard default due date for agency reports to the City Council when a law does not already specify one. Reports covering less than a year would be due at the end of the month after the reporting period ends, while reports covering a year or more would be due at the end of the second month after. It also standardizes how terms like month, quarter and fiscal year are defined in reporting laws.
